cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Admit You’re Hurt
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit hurt, fear, or disappointment before you reveal that you feel it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll draft our reply to the boss. Did being called office furniture hurt you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you putting my name on a complaint?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not without you reading it. Tell me how it felt first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Invisible. I've worked here twelve years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Me too. Read this before I send it: 'I went home and cried.'

reason: Negotiate actual control of attribution before B admission; A5 finally reveals shared pain in a draft B is invited to inspect, without an extra summary of the emotional mechanism.
